nodes.statement: The solution space for linear constraints is rigid (low-dimensional), so N_c(w) will remain flat as w increases.

The non-convex loss landscape of small networks may create spurious local minima that prevent zero-violation at certain widths, causing N_c(w) to appear increasing even if the solution space is rigid.

The minimal width N_c(w) is determined by the network's ability to represent the solution manifold; for rigid families, N_c(w) will be constant and small (e.g., 2-4), while for fat families, N_c(w) will increase with w as more capacity is needed to capture the higher-dimensional solution space.

The solution space for linear constraints is rigid (low-dimensional), so N_c(w) will remain flat as w increases. | This hypothesis is the most testable because the ground truth (linear function is uniquely determined by 2 points) is analytically known and the prediction (flat N_c(w)) is straightforward to verify numerically. It also serves as a necessary baseline for the more complex fat family hypothesis. While it may seem trivial, establishing this baseline is essential before interpreting results for the fat case, and the experimental design (multi-seed, L-BFGS-B optimization) can rigorously rule out optimization artifacts that might otherwise be misinterpreted as rigidity.

新假设：**将“最小宽度 N_c(w)”替换为“达到零违规所需的最小训练迭代步数 T_c(w)”作为刚性探针——刚性系统因解空间狭窄，优化路径短、收敛快；胖系统因解空间庞大，需更多迭代才能遍历并拟合留外出点，T_c(w) 随 w 递增。**

nodes.statement: 新假设：**以“最小零违规宽度对初始扰动的敏感度”作为解空间刚性的探针，而非直接测量宽度随样本数的增长趋势。**
新假设：解空间刚性可通过“达到零违规的最小宽度 N_c(w) 与最小迭代步数 T_c(w) 的联合单调性”共同判定——刚性系统表现为 N_c(w) 不增且 T_c(w) 随 w 递减或持平，胖系统则 N_c(w) 递增或 T_c(w) 随 w 显著递增。
